hook: TGSRTC puts a controller at *86* busiest bus stations
hook_b: TGSRTC puts a controller at *86* busiest bus stations
tldr: TGSRTC will install CCTV at all bus stations and has added controllers, enquiry numbers and PA systems at 86 major stations.

beats.what: New timetable boards are coming soon; PA systems will announce first and last bus timings.
beats.why: The plan targets passenger safety, crowd management and easier bus information.
beats.care: At big stations you can now ask a controller or call a dedicated enquiry number for timings.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today: 86 stations with over 5,000 daily footfall got a controller, enquiry numbers and PA systems; CCTV planned at all stations, linked to regional offices and HQ.

cards.q: How do you usually find bus timings?

qs: Which Hyderabad stations are among the 86?
Will the CCTV feeds be used for crowd alerts during festivals?

facts.t: Each of the 86 stations records *over 5,000* passengers a day.

steps.e: CCTV at all stations, linked to HQ

viz.verdict: Passengers get more on-site bus information

watch: New timetable boards are due soon at all stations; CCTV rollout timeline not given.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: RTC plans CCTVs and augmentation of passenger facilities at 86 bus stations

fact: TGSRTC's *86* busiest stations, each over *5,000* daily passengers, now get controllers.
twist: CCTV feeds from all bus stations will stream straight to regional offices and RTC headquarters.
